IEHG-GL-M1.description: Inelastic Hinge Assignment for General Link (IEHG-GL-M1). Assigns a previously defined Inelastic Hinge Property to a general-link object; the assignment is keyed by object id and links to the named property.

INEL_PROP_NAME.description: Name of an existing Inelastic Hinge Property to assign. Must match a defined Inelastic Hinge Property name; assignment fails (LV_WRONG_DATA) if no property with this name exists.
